summary: Iteration 5 verified the three-feature addition (Payment ledger + full-digit KPI + Custom date-range report). All 39/39 pytest cases pass: 15 new + 24 regression from previous iteration. Backend: static + runtime checks confirm Payment/PaymentCreate models, Booking.payments field, POST /api/bookings/{id}/payments endpoint with correct auth/validation/atomic $push+$inc logic (401 without bearer, 400 for amount<=0, 404 for missing booking, 400 for amount>balance), and seed_bookings now inserts an initial Payment when advance>0. Frontend static: theme.ts formatINRFull returns '₹...,.../-', dashboard.tsx uses formatINRFull (not compact) + imports/renders ReportModal with testID report-btn, BookingDetailSheet.tsx renders 'Payment History' iterating booking.payments and calls onAddPayment(booking.id, amt), invoice.ts has paymentsSectionHtml + buildReportHtml (A4 landscape, 4 KPI tiles, Payments column) + exported shareReport, and ReportModal.tsx has all required testIDs (report-start-date, report-end-date, generate-report-btn, and 4 preset testIDs via `report-preset-${p.key}` template). Live UI smoke: login screen renders with 'Continue with Google' button, no red screen. Full E2E collect-payment / generate-report flows are Google-OAuth-gated and cannot be tested end-to-end from pytest — recommended for main-agent manual verification.
action_items: Main agent to manually log in with a Google account and: (a) seed bookings, open one with advance>0 in the detail sheet and confirm 'Payment History' shows the initial advance row + timestamp, (b) tap 'Collect Payment', enter a partial amount and confirm a NEW ledger row is appended (both in the sheet and in the shared PDF invoice's Payment History table), (c) confirm dashboard KPI values now show full digits like '₹3,80,000/-' (not '₹3.8L'), (d) tap the new report-btn (document icon) in the appbar, pick a range (or a preset) and confirm the landscape PDF opens with 4 KPI tiles + all bookings including the Payments column.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py::add_payment correctly performs auth first, then payload validation (amount<=0 → 400), booking lookup (404), balance check (>balance → 400) and finally an atomic single-doc update with $push payments + $inc advancePaid. Race-safe for concurrent collect operations on the same booking.

server.py seed_bookings builds an initial Payment ONLY when adv>0 and stamps it with a plausible past date (now - |days_off|-3 days). Fully-paid completed booking (adv=180000) also gets a proper ledger entry.
theme.ts: formatINRCompact is still exported (may be dead code after dashboard migration) — safe to leave for now, but consider removing in a future cleanup.
BookingDetailSheet.tsx correctly clamps collect amount client-side (amt>balance → Alert) BEFORE calling onAddPayment, so the 400 from backend is a defense-in-depth backstop.
ReportModal.tsx uses native @react-native-community/datetimepicker with proper iOS wrap-in-Modal and Android inline-picker pattern; onChange handles the 'dismissed' event correctly.
invoice.ts buildReportHtml sorts filtered bookings by eventDate ascending and correctly falls back to 'Initial advance' row when payments[] is empty but advancePaid>0 — matches the sheet behaviour.
Minor: FastAPI on_event('startup'/'shutdown') deprecated warnings persist (not blocking). Suggest lifespan migration on next backend refactor.
